references.text: The description of Passover in Exodus and how it is to be celebrated provides the background for understanding Jesus' words about celebrating Passover with his disciples.
The book of Psalms contains several messianic prophecies that can be seen in light of Jesus' reference to 'my time is near'.
Isaiah speaks of a suffering servant, which can be connected to Jesus' sacrifice and his reference to Passover.
Luke gives a parallel account of the preparations for the Passover meal, emphasizing the significance of Jesus' words in Matthew.
John provides a detailed description of the Passover meal, giving context to Jesus' words about celebrating it with his disciples.
Acts mentions 'God's appointed times', which can be related to Jesus' statement that 'my time is near'.
